text.body: atha prātiśākhyapradīpaśikṣā''rabhyate herambaṃ vighnahartāraṃ praṇamāmi sarasvatīm yayornnamanamātreṇa vighnasaṅgho vinaśyati 1 prātiśākhyaṃ ca śikṣāśca samyagālocya yatnataḥ vaidikānāṃ mubodhāya samyakpāṭhasya siddhaye 2 sadāśivatanūjena bālakṛṣṇena dhīmatā prātiśākhyapradīpākhyā śikṣā samyaṅnirūpyate 3 atha vedādhyayanaprakāraḥ | tatra yājñavalkyāḥ | praṇavaṃ prākprayuñjīta vyāhṛtīstadanantaram sāvitrīṃ cānupūrvvyeṇa tato vedānsamārabhet 1 hastau tu saṃyyutau dhāryyau jānvoruparisaṃsthitau guroranumatiṃ kṛtvā paṭhennānyamatirbhavet 2 ūrubhāge tṛtīye tu karannyasyātha dakṣiṇam prasannamānaso bhūtvā kiñcinnamramadho mukhaḥ 3 kūrmo'ṅgānīva saṃhṛtya hastadṛṣṭirdṛḍhammanaḥ svasthaḥ praśānto nirbhīto varṇānuccārayedbudhaḥ 4 nāmyāhannyānna nirhannyānna gāyenna ca kampayet yathādāvuccaredvarṇāṃstathaivaitāntsamāpayet 5 niveśya dṛṣṭiṃ hastāgre vedārthamanu cintayet samyaguccārayedvarṇānhastena ca mukhena ca 6 svaraścaiva tu hastaśca dvāvetau yugapatsthitau hastādbhraṣṭaḥ svarādbhraṣṭo na vedaphalamaśnute 7 na karālo na lamboṣṭho nāvyakto nānusikaḥ gadgado baddhajihvaśca na varṇānvaktumarhati 8 culurnnaukā sphuṭo daṇḍī svastiko muṣṭikākṛtiḥ ete vai hastadoṣāḥ syuḥ paraśaśceti saptamaḥ 9 atha karacālanakramastatraiva aṅguṣṭhasyottare parvve tarjjannyupari yadbhavet prādeśasya tu yo deśastanmātraṃ cālayetkaram 10 udāttaṃ mruvi pātena pracayaṃ | svargyāyeti svaḥ gyāya | prasave'śśvinoḥ | parameṣṭṭhyabhidhītaḥ | sucīveti | svaritapare yathā svāhā svarṇārkkaḥ | ityevamādayaḥ | ubhayavāntsvaritaḥ 6 ūrdhvādho bhāge niṣpannaḥ svaraḥ praśliṣṭaḥ 12 hrasva ikāra udāttaḥ paraśca hrasva ikāro'nudāttastayoḥ parasparapraśliṣṭe praśliṣṭasvaro bhavati | yathā abhi indhatām | abhīndhatām | srucīva | tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ | ikāro dṛśyate yatra ikāreṇaiva saṃyyutaḥ | udāttaścānudāttena praśliṣṭo bhavati svaraḥ | 18 svaro vyañjanayutastairovyañjanaḥ 13 udāttātpūrvasmātparo yaḥ svaro vyañjanayutaḥ sa tairovyañjanasañjñakaḥ svaro bhavati | yathā iḍe | rante | tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ | udāttapūrvaṃ yyatkiñcidvyañjanena ca saṃyyutaḥ | eṣa sarvabahusvārastairovyañjanasañjñakaḥ 19 udavagrahastairovirāmaḥ 14 udāttāvagrahastairovirāmasañjñakaḥ syāt | ayaṃ ca samastapadeṣu bhavati | avagrahavacanāt | avagrahābhāve tu tairovyañjana eva | yathā gopatāviti go | patau | yajñapatimitiyajña | patim | tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ | avagrahātparo yastu svaritaḥ syādanantaram | tairovirāmaṃ taṃ viddyādudātto yadyavagrahaḥ 20 vivṛttilakṣaṇaḥ pādavṛttaḥ 15 svarayorantaraṃ vivṛttirucyate | tayā lakṣyata iti
